title: Main explanation
text:
How We Checked
We analyzed 1 million real matches from the Clash Royale API to see if opponents’ cards were influenced by your deck. Here’s the process:

Scraped the data — Pulled 1 million match records from the official Clash Royale API
Compared distributions — Looked at how often each card appeared against you vs. how often it appears overall
Measured the difference — Used statistical testing to see if there was a meaningful gap

Learn more about how we scraped the data →

title: Main explanation
text:
What We Found
Mean Absolute Deviation: 0.0989%
This number tells us how much the cards you faced deviated from what we’d expect by random chance. At just 0.01%, it’s extremely small—basically noise.
In practical terms: if a card appears in 5% of all matches, you’ll face it roughly 5% of the time, regardless of your deck. There’s no hidden algorithm adjusting opponents to hard-counter you.
